note: Written by hand from what the demo builds; see README for how status is decided.

capabilities.notes: Direct end labels, legend toggle, axis tooltip.
Line series with stack and areaStyle.
Rounded value end only, as the design asks.
Several bar series side by side.
Item tooltip with both coordinates.
Scatter with symbolSize as a function of the third value. No built-in size legend: the subtitle explains it.
Category x category grid; piecewise legend with explicit bins.
Drill by click, breadcrumb. The built-in legend does not list tree nodes, so an HTML legend (design .legend) is used.
Click a segment to zoom. Same HTML legend note as the treemap.
No facet or trellis API: 16 grids, axes and series are positioned by hand and the panel layout is recomputed per width (4 columns, 3 on phones).
No dedicated type: a two-point line series per entity with end labels; labels collide, labelLayout.hideOverlap hides some of them.
Inverse category-like value axis over rank series; ranks are computed by our code (VotwCore.rankByColumn), the library does not rank.
Indexing is our code (VotwCore.indexSeries); the library only draws the result. Dashed 100 line is a markLine.
Mouse hover and tap (triggerOn mousemove|click). Styled from tokens, content in the design's tooltip layout.
Built-in legend for series charts, piecewise visualMap for heatmaps and maps, HTML legend for treemap, sunburst, small multiples and slope.
Bar ranking re-sorts live with realtimeSort while the year changes; values tween. Durations come from tokens; zero under reduced motion.
Bars to pie to treemap with universalTransition and the same data group id.

capabilities.capability: Timeline playback with year slider and play button
capabilities.notes: Uses the design system's year-player component (range + play) to call setOption; the ECharts timeline component was not used because it does not match the design controls.
Design place-toggle component; the state re-renders all linked views. Villages have no city points, so the city scatter and bubble map only offer big and small cities.
Rectangle brush on the scatter; brushSelected event feeds our own state and re-draws the linked bar chart. Several charts also react to map clicks.
Not demonstrated: our linking goes through shared page state because the views show different data. connect (shared tooltip and zoom between charts) exists in the API but is not built here.

capabilities.capability: Zoom and pan on a chart
capabilities.notes: dataZoom inside (wheel, pinch, drag) plus slider on the timeline.
Map series joined by TERYT code with nameProperty (names are not guaranteed unique at gmina level). Piecewise bins from design tokens.
Hatched fill through itemStyle.decal, plus a legend entry. Never drawn as 0.
No built-in drill-down: one map is registered per voivodeship (registerMap) and our click handler swaps the series; breadcrumb and back button are ours.
Scatter series on the geo component, symbolSize = sqrt(value); 1,020 points, per place-type colour.
Piecewise visualMap with bins; no-data swatch as HTML.

capabilities.capability: Hover and tap tooltips on maps
capabilities.notes: Verified with mouse hover and with a tap under touch emulation at 375 px.
The select computes centre and zoom from the region bounding box (VotwCore.zoomTo); the zoom factor is an approximation, not an exact fit. Scroll, drag and pinch are the built-in roam.
Tap (tooltip, drill-down) verified in Chromium touch emulation at 375 px. Two-finger pinch zoom was not tested on a real device.
Not in this demo to keep the download small (0.9 MB). Issue #12 measured it in ECharts; see research/viz-libraries.
ECharts draws only the shapes you give it. A basemap needs a second library (MapLibre GL JS, see the library report).
The library does not read CSV: 25 lines of our own parser (quotes, CRLF, BOM) with unit tests.
Plain fetch and JSON.parse, any shape, then mapped into series.
registerMap takes a FeatureCollection directly.
Not read natively: topojson-client 3.1.0 (vendored) converts it to GeoJSON first.
getDataURL, then our code adds title, subtitle, DEMO flag and source line on a canvas.
Re-renders the same option in a detached SSR instance with the SVG renderer; wrapper adds title and source. Fonts are referenced by name, not embedded.
Our code; every chart defines csv(); rows end with a demo_flag column. Library has no data export without the toolbox dataView.
Not built and not a library feature; print the page or convert the SVG.
Container-width-driven heights and label density; verified with no horizontal scroll at 375, 768 and 1280.
Colours are read from the CSS tokens and the chart option is rebuilt on a themechange event; the library has no live token binding, so the page triggers the redraw.
Skeleton, empty with reset, error with retry; the failure path is tested by blocking the data file.
Created by Votw.figure; the figure throws without a source; the check script fails on any card without one.
ECharts canvas marks cannot be focused or stepped through with the keyboard. Alternative: a table view for every chart, and aria description text.
aria.enabled generates a description and the container has role img with the title; this is a summary, not per-mark navigation.
Animation durations are 0 when prefers-reduced-motion is set; the year player does not tween.
UMD file vendored (1,122 KB raw per the library report), plain script tags, opens from python3 -m http.server.
